label: CRM with payments
prompt: Build a CRM with login, contacts management, deals pipeline, dashboard with analytics, role-based access for admin and sales reps, and a premium plan with Stripe payments. Admins can see all analytics.

label: E-commerce store
prompt: Build an e-commerce platform with product listings, shopping cart, checkout with payments, order tracking, admin panel for managing products and orders, and customer accounts with order history.

label: Project management tool
prompt: Build a project management app like Trello. Users can create boards, lists, and cards. Cards have due dates, assignees, labels, and comments. Teams can collaborate on boards. Admin can manage members.

label: SaaS blog platform
prompt: Build a multi-tenant blog platform. Each user gets their own blog with custom domain support. Posts support markdown, tags, categories, and SEO metadata. Public readers don't need accounts. Monetize via subscriptions.

label: Job board
prompt: Build a job board where companies can post jobs and candidates can apply. Companies have profiles and dashboards to manage job postings and review applications. Candidates upload resumes and track application status.

label: Booking system
prompt: Build an appointment booking system for a clinic. Doctors have schedules with available slots. Patients book appointments, get email reminders, and can cancel or reschedule. Admin manages doctors and sees all bookings.

label: Learning management system
prompt: Build an LMS where instructors create courses with video lessons, quizzes, and assignments. Students enroll, track progress, submit assignments, and earn certificates. Admin manages users and content moderation.

label: Inventory management
prompt: Build an inventory management system for a warehouse. Track products, stock levels, suppliers, purchase orders, and shipments. Alert when stock is low. Generate reports on inventory value and movement history.

label: Social media app
prompt: Build a social media app where users post photos and videos, follow each other, like and comment on posts, send direct messages, and see a personalized feed. Include notifications and content moderation for admins.

label: Restaurant ordering
prompt: Build an online ordering system for restaurants. Customers browse menus, add items to cart, and pay. Restaurant staff manage orders on a dashboard with status updates. Admin configures menu items, prices, and hours.

label: Vague — no entities
prompt: Build me an app for my business.

label: Conflicting requirements
prompt: Build an app where all data is completely private and nobody can see anyone else's data, but also build a public dashboard that shows all user data and activity in real time.

label: Underspecified — missing roles
prompt: Build a dashboard with charts and tables.

label: Contradictory auth
prompt: Build a platform with no login required but also with premium content that only paid subscribers can access and admin-only sections.

label: Extremely complex
prompt: Build a hospital management system with patients, doctors, nurses, departments, wards, beds, appointments, prescriptions, lab tests, radiology, billing, insurance claims, inventory, HR, payroll, and a mobile app for patients.

label: Technology mismatch
prompt: Build a blockchain-based voting system using AI and quantum encryption where votes are anonymous but also fully auditable and every vote is stored on-chain in real time.

label: Technical jargon only
prompt: Build me a CQRS event-sourced microservice with saga orchestration for handling distributed transactions.

label: Single word
prompt: CRM

label: Feature creep
prompt: Build an app that does everything — social media, e-commerce, project management, video streaming, email, calendar, file storage, AI chat, cryptocurrency wallet, and food delivery, all in one.

label: Mid-stream requirement change
prompt: Build a simple todo app. Actually make it a team collaboration tool. Wait no, make it a full project management platform with time tracking, billing clients, and integrations with GitHub and Slack.
